name: Inyumoniya
tagline: Umbulali ophezulu wabaneminyaka engaphansi kwemi-5 nangaphezulu kweminyaka engama-65.

urgent.heading: Kuyaphuthuma — bona umtholampilo manje
urgent.primary_message: Inyumoniya ezinganeni ezincane nakubantu asebekhulile ingabulala emahoreni ambalwa. Ukuphefumula kanzima, izindebe eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, ubuthakathaka obukhulu - ukuya esibhedlela.
red_flags: Ukuphefumula kanzima noma ukuphefumula ngokushesha okukhulu
Izindebe eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, iminwe, noma ubuso
Awukwazi ukugcina uketshezi luphansi - ukuhlanza yonke into
Ubuhlungu besifuba obuba bubi nakakhulu ngokuphefumula
Ukudideka noma ukozela okungajwayelekile, ikakhulukazi kubantu asebekhulile
Enganeni engaphansi kweminyaka emi-5: ukuncela isifuba phakathi kwezimbambo, ukwenqaba ukondla, ukungabi naluhle
Ukukhwehlela kukhiqiza amafinyila anombala wokugqwala, oluhlaza okotshani, noma onemithende yegazi

what_is_it.heading: Inyumoniya ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: Inyumoniya ukutheleleka kwamasaka omoya (alveoli) ephashini elilodwa noma womabili. Amasaka agcwala uketshezi noma ubomvu, okwenza kube nzima ukuphefumula futhi alambe umzimba womoya-mpilo.
paragraphs: Iningi lenyumoniya libangelwa amagciwane - iStreptococcus pneumoniae ivame kakhulu. Amagciwane kanye nesikhunta nakho kungabangela. Ukutheleleka kuvame ukulandela umkhuhlane noma umkhuhlane, lapho amasosha omzimba ebuthakathaka.

Abantu abadala abanempilo ngokuvamile bayalulama ngama-antibiotics noma ukunakekelwa okusekelayo. Ingozi igxile emaqenjini amathathu: izingane ezingaphansi kweminyaka emi-5, abantu abadala abangaphezu kweminyaka engama-65, kanye nabantu abanezimo ezingamahlalakhona noma i-HIV. Kula maqembu, inyumoniya ingelinye lamaqembu abulala kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika.

items.headline: Umbulali ophezulu
items.body: Inyumoniya iphakathi kwezimbangela ezihamba phambili zokufa ezinganeni zaseNingizimu Afrika ezineminyaka engaphansi kwemi-5 kanye nabantu abadala abangaphezu kweminyaka engama-65.

items.headline: Umgomo-uvikeleke
items.body: Umuthi wokugomela i-pneumococcal — mahhala ezinganeni, unconyelwe abaneminyaka engaphezu kuka-65 kanye nesifo esingamahlalakhona. Isika uhlobo oluvame kakhulu kakhulu.

items.headline: Kuyalapheka
items.body: Inyumoniya yebhaktheriya iphendula kuma-antibiotics phakathi nezinsuku. Ukwelashwa kufanele kuqedwe ngokugcwele - ungayeki kusenesikhathi.

items.headline: Ngokuvamile kulandela umkhuhlane
items.body: Amanyumoniya amaningi aqala njengesifo sesifuba esibangelwa amagciwane. Yingakho umkhuhlane oba mkhulu ngemva kwezinsuku ezingu-5-7 udinga ukuhlolwa kodokotela.

pull_quote.text: Inyumoniya enganeni encane ingasuka ekukhwehleleni iye kobucayi emahoreni angama-24. Uma ingane iphefumula ngokushesha, yenqaba ukondla, noma inesifuba sokudonsa - ungalindi ekuseni. Hamba manje.

signs.heading: Ibukeka kanjani inyumoniya
signs.lede: Izimpawu zenyumoniya zisukela kokuhamba kancane-inyumoniya kuye kobunzima futhi obusongela ukuphila. Izingane kanye nabantu abadala bavame ukubonisa izimpawu ze-atypical.

items.title: Izimpawu zakudala
items.description: Ukukhwehlela (okuvame ukuba namafinyila aminyene aluhlaza, aphuzi, noma anombala wokugqwala), imfiva kanye namakhaza, ukuphefumula kanzima, ubuhlungu besifuba oba bubhebhetheka kakhulu lapho uphefumula.

items.title: Abantu abadala bangase bangabi nawo umkhuhlane
items.description: Abantu abadala asebekhulile bavame ukuvela ngokudideka, ubuthakathaka, ukuwa, noma ukuwohloka kwezimo ezingaphansi - ngaphandle komkhuhlane osobala noma ukukhwehlela.

items.title: Izingane
items.description: Ukuphefumula okusheshayo, ukudonsa isifuba (ukudonsa isikhumba phakathi noma ngaphansi kwezimbambo ngokuphefumula ngakunye), ukwenqaba ukudla, ukuququda, izindebe eziluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka - lokhu kudinga ukunakwa ngokushesha.

spreads.heading: Indlela inyumoniya esakazeka ngayo
yes: Ukukhwehlela kanye nokuthimula okusabalalisa amagciwane noma amagciwane avela kubantu abanaleli gciwane
Ukuxhumana okusondelene kakhulu nemindeni, inkulisa, noma ezindlini zokunakekela
Ukuphefumula kokudla, okuphuzwayo, noma okuphakathi kwesisu emaphashini (kubantu abadala asebekhulile noma ababuthaka)
Ukulandela okunye ukutheleleka kokuphefumula njengomkhuhlane noma i-COVID

prevention.heading: Indlela yokunciphisa ingozi
prevention.lede: Inyumoniya eningi ezinganeni ezincane, asebekhulile, kanye nabantu abanezifo ezingelapheki ingavinjelwa ngemijovo, ukugeza izandla, nokwelapha izifo zokuphefumula kusenesikhathi.

items.title: Umuthi wokugomela i-pneumococcal
items.description: Kumahhala kubantwana emavikini ayisi-6, amasonto ayi-14, nezinyanga eziyi-9. Inconyelwe abantu abadala abangaphezu kweminyaka engama-65 kanye nesifo esingamahlalakhona - buza emtholampilo.

items.title: Umgomo wonyaka womkhuhlane
items.description: Umkhuhlane uvame ukuholela e-pneumonia. Ukuvimbela umkhuhlane kuvimbela amanyumoniya amaningi esibili. Kumahhala emaqenjini anobungozi obukhulu.

items.title: Ungabhemi
items.description: Ukubhema kulimaza ukuzivikela kwamaphaphu futhi kuyingozi enkulu yenyumoniya. Ukuyeka kunciphisa ingozi phakathi nezinyanga.

items.title: Ukuhlanzeka kwezandla
items.description: Geza izandla njalo, ikakhulukazi eduze kwezingane ezincane, izihlobo esezikhulile, nanoma ubani onesifo esingamahlalakhona.

items.fact: Inyumoniya ingahlasela kunoma iyiphi iminyaka. Izingane, abantu abasha, abasubathi - bonke bayakuthola. Kwabaningi kuyelapheka - kodwa kufanele kwelashwe.

items.myth: Amakhambi okukhwehlela nomusi kwanele ukwelapha inyumoniya.
items.fact: I-bacterial pneumonia idinga ama-antibiotics. Amakhambi e-steam nasekhaya angadambisa izimpawu kodwa ngeke akuqede ukutheleleka. Bonana nodokotela.

items.myth: Uma ngizizwa ngingcono ngemva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, ngingakwazi ukumisa ama-antibiotic ami.
items.fact: Ukumisa ama-antibiotic kusenesikhathi kuvumela amanye amagciwane ukuthi asinde, amelane, futhi kubuyise ukutheleleka - kwesinye isikhathi kubi kakhulu. Qedela isifundo esigcwele.

items.myth: Inyumoniya ihlale ifana - yelaphe kanye bese uqeda.
items.fact: Amagciwane ahlukene adala inyumoniya ehlukene, kanti ama-antibiotic afanele ayahluka. Yingakho udokotela - hhayi ukuzelapha - kufanele akhethe indlela yokwelapha.

items.title: Bonana nomtholampilo nganoma yikuphi ukutheleleka kwesifuba okuqhubekayo
items.description: Ukukhwehlela okungathuthuki ngemva kwezinsuku eziyi-7, ikakhulukazi uma kunomkhuhlane, ubuhlungu besifuba, noma ukuphefumula kanzima, kudinga ukuhlolwa kodokotela.

items.title: Uma uxilongwa - thatha inkambo ephelele yama-antibiotic
items.description: Inyumoniya yebhaktheriya eminingi yelashwa ngezinsuku ezi-5-7 zama-antibiotics. Thatha wonke umthamo ngisho noma uzizwa ungcono - ukuyeka kusenesikhathi kungavumela ukutheleleka kuphindaphindeke.

items.title: Phumula ngokugcwele uze ululame
items.description: Inyumoniya iwuqeda amandla umzimba. Hlela okungenani isonto lonke ungasebenzi noma esikoleni. Ukudlula ekubambezelekeni kokululama futhi kubeka engcupheni izinkinga.

items.title: Qaphela izimpawu eziyingozi
items.description: Ukuphefumula okusheshayo noma okukhandlekayo, izindebe eziluhlaza, ukudideka, ubuhlungu besifuba, ukungakwazi ukugcina uketshezi luphansi - phuthuma esibhedlela.

items.title: Thola imithi yokugoma ngemva kokululama
items.description: Uma usululeme, buza umtholampilo wakho mayelana nemithi yokugomela i-pneumococcal kanye nomkhuhlane uma ungakaze ube nayo. Ivimbela isiqephu esilandelayo.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: Inyumoniya ethambile ingelashwa ekhaya ngama-antibiotics avela emtholampilo. Inyumoniya enzima iyisimo esiphuthumayo sasesibhedlela.
